name: Nanda Giri
bio: Nanda Giri is an Indonesian film casting director.

credits.title: Secrets
credits.overview: A single mother’s carefully rebuilt life with her daughter is threatened when her dark, violent past resurfaces, forcing her to confront old wounds and hidden truths that could unravel everything she has fought for.

credits.title: A Letter to My Youth
credits.overview: A rebellious teen and a reserved caretaker form an unlikely bond in an orphanage as they come to terms with their painful pasts.

credits.title: Perempuan Bergaun Merah
credits.overview: Since her best friend disappeared, Dinda's life turns into a nightmare when an evil spirit in the form of a woman in a red dress haunts her. Dinda's life is threatened, not only by the evil spirit but also by people who try to keep the events of the night of her best friend's disappearance a secret.

credits.title: Photocopier
credits.overview: When photos of her at a party cause her to lose a scholarship, a student investigates whether something devastating happened to her that night.

credits.title: Run to the Beach
credits.overview: Sam and her mother Uci, are about to do a road trip to G-Land beach in Banyuwangi. Sam's cousin, Happy, who's 180° different from Sam also came along on the road trip.

credits.title: Pesan Dari Samudra
credits.overview: At Lawaloba on the island of Flores, there was an old man Opa Hali, struggling againts the closure of an emergency lane to the hill which was the only shorcut for the population to survive in the event of tsunami disaster.

credits.title: Sang Penjahit
credits.overview: Syarif, an army veteran turned tailor, has an order to sew a large Indonesian flag. He becomes overwhelmed when the almost finished flag is ruined because of a coffee spill.

credits.title: Fiction.
credits.overview: When a sheltered young woman becomes enamored with a struggling writer, she goes to great lengths to become involved in his creative process.
